description: This file defines a WebServerPlugin class for managing web server processes within the Playwright testing framework, including starting, stopping, and monitoring server availability, with configuration options and process handling logic.

classes.name: WebServerPlugin
classes.description: A class implementing the TestRunnerPlugin interface to manage web server processes during testing, including setup, teardown, and process monitoring.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the web server process, checks for existing availability, and waits for server readiness.

methods.name: _startProcess
methods.description: Starts the web server process with specified options and sets up output monitoring.

methods.name: _waitForProcess
methods.description: Waits until the server is available or times out.
